title: Identify what this yes changes
when: When the first work-approval, evidence-review or release-approval request appears.
need: Work approval, QA evidence review and release approval settle different obligations. Each card should name its subject, evidence, decision and consequence. A delivery notice asks for nothing.
surface: Inbox, item QA and run pages; workflow approval defaults
gap: Current cards carry these distinctions; catalog has no explicit approval-learning situation. Review question: should JOURNEYS add a first-decision explanation that links its exact evidence?
